status: Reference candidate for elizaOS develop (release-22 DeviceApps part); not applied to Alpha's build and not submitted upstream. Alpha's renderer uses its own DeviceApps plugin (list/launch/resolveDefault/openDefault) until this lands.
summary: Exposes the generic launcher surface on the ElizaSystem Capacitor plugin: listLauncherApps({icons?}), launchApp({packageName}), resolveDefaultApp({role:'dial'}) and openDefaultApp({role:'dial'}), with TypeScript definitions and an honest web fallback (no apps, no default handler, launches refused).

contract.listLauncherApps: {apps:[{packageName,label,icon?}]}; icons only when options.icons === true, as data:image/png;base64 at 96 px
contract.launchApp: invalid or host package -> reject 'Choose an installed app'; unresolvable -> reject 'App is unavailable'; otherwise startActivity in a new task
contract.resolveDefaultApp: role other than 'dial' -> reject; resolves without launching
contract.openDefaultApp: role other than 'dial' -> reject; no handler -> reject; otherwise ACTION_DIAL tel: (empty dial pad) in a new task
